proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition effect for spells
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell Effect type (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no apply_condition variant. Animal Friendship's save gate onFail is purely a condition application — there is no damage component. The activation family's save_gate phase cannot express this without widening Effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: charmed (and full standard Condition set)
proposed_widenings.justification: Condition is currently limited to 'prone'. Animal Friendship requires 'charmed'. All standard SRD 5.2.1 conditions (charmed, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, etc.) will be needed as this survey progresses.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...or have the Charmed condition for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: Duration conditional-break (self_break on damage)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Duration type supports timed/concentration/instantaneous but not 'timed duration with an early-termination trigger'. Animal Friendship ends early when the caster or an ally deals damage to the target — a self_break condition. The v4 lifecycle atom self_break exists but the Duration surface type has no variant to express it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: creature-type filter on target attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: The target attachment has no creature-type predicate. Animal Friendship is restricted to Beasts. This is a narrower authoring constraint than the engine enforces, but its absence means the authored surface cannot faithfully represent the eligibility restriction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Target a Beast that you can see within range.

notes: The structural skeleton fits cleanly: activation family, save_gate phase, timed duration, slot-scaling target count (identical to Bless pattern). Every blocker is a missing surface variant, not a missing family or missing v4 atom. apply_condition exists in v4; charmed is a standard SRD condition; self_break is in v4 lifecycle. Once Effect gains apply_condition and Condition is widened to include the standard set, this spell encodes cleanly with no further widenings. The beast-only filter is a secondary authoring gap — not a blocker if the engine enforces eligibility elsewhere.
